# DesignerPeople

> > DesignerPeople is a Delhi-based design and branding agency specializing in packaging design, brand strategy, UI/UX services, and digital marketing for businesses across India.

The agency offers comprehensive branding solutions including logo design, packaging design for food and pharmaceutical products, exhibition stall design, and social media marketing. Their work emphasizes design thinking principles and serves entrepreneurs and businesses looking to establish or refresh their brand identity in the Indian market.

- Brand Identity & Logo Design
- Packaging Design
- UI/UX Design Services
- Brand Strategy & Positioning
- Design Thinking Process
- Digital Marketing & Social Media
- Food & Beverage Branding
- Pharmaceutical Packaging
- Exhibition Stall Design
- Value Proposition Development
- Sustainable Packaging Trends
- Indian Market & Startups
- Brand Refresh Strategies
- Typography & Hindi Design
- Gen Z Marketing Trends
